mutations.label: the shape comparison never fails, and the regression of 2026-09-04 reads as a table that survived (#671)
mutations.find:
[ -z "$changed" ] \
		|| fail "$stack: $name ($machine) does not carry $moment what it carried before the restart
mutations.replace:
[ -z "$changed" ] || true \
		|| fail "$stack: $name ($machine) does not carry $moment what it carried before the restart

mutations.label: the route reader keeps the connected routes, and the comparison compares the address twice (#671)
mutations.find:
if (via == "" || dev == "") next
		print "route " dst " via " via " dev " dev
mutations.replace:
if ((via == "" && 0) || dev == "") next
		print "route " dst " via " via " dev " dev

mutations.label: the route reader keeps the link-local block, the kernel's own plumbing (#671)
the address reader ignores the scope, and a scope-link address reads as a change across a restart (#671)
a capture that failed compares as an empty side, and reads as a table that changed or survived rather than as nobody looking (#671)
mutations.find:
[ -s "$after" ] \
		|| fail "cannot look: the shape of $name ($machine) could not be read $moment
mutations.replace:
[ -s "$after" ] || true \
		|| fail "cannot look: the shape of $name ($machine) could not be read $moment

mutations.label: the reader control stops checking that the comparison finds a planted difference (#671)
mutations.find: if (fnl_shape_survives_restart control planted m "$before" "$after" "after a planted restart") >/dev/null 2>&1; then
mutations.replace: if (fnl_shape_survives_restart control planted m "$before" "$after" "after a planted restart") >/dev/null 2>&1 && false; then

mutations.label: the route reader keeps a route held at two metrics twice, and a reboot reads as a table that changed (#671, #673)
mutations.find:
print "route " dst " via " via " dev " dev
	}' | sort -u
mutations.replace:
print "route " dst " via " via " dev " dev
	}' | cat -u | sort
